messages:
mira: Heads up — we're seeing a small but reproducible mismatch in outputs for quant-v4b models on Dedicated eu-west when runtime 3.2.0 is used. Not widespread but triggered by large batch sizes.

sam: Oof. Did this start after the kernel update yesterday? @deploy-bot any pinned runtimes affected?

deploy-bot: Deploy audit: runtime 3.2.0 rolled to dedicated-eu-west at 2026-03-19T22:10Z. Pinned models: quant-v4b-1, llama3q-2. No active pins.

jin: Confirmed this correlates with driver 540.2 update on those hosts. Works fine on hosted and dedicated-us.

mira: Recommending a short pin-hold for runtime 3.2.0 on dedicated-eu-west until we validate. Proposed action: route requests for quant-v4b in eu-west to dedicated-us or hosted to avoid regression exposure.

katy: Agree. What about customer SLAs? ops-asia, do we need to notify APAC customers?

ops-asia: APAC customers will be fine if eu-west routes to hosted, but we should call out increased tail latency and update support playbooks.

sam: Plan: 1) Apply a pin-hold flag on runtime=3.2.0 region=eu-west; 2) Add a deploybot routing override for model_family=quant-v4b -> hosted fallback; 3) Post incident-safe announcement and update the release notes. Can oncall run the preflight test deck on eu-west with 20k tokens?

oncall-eng: Running tests now. ETA ~12m.

oncall-eng: Preflight logs: failing token sequences at batch_size=48, reproducing the divergence. Uploading snippet: ```diff
- logits[0:5] expected
+ logits[0:5] observed mismatch
```

mira: Good capture. If failures are deterministic we should block further unpins and plan rollback of kernel 540.2 to 535.x on a canary pool.

sam: Can infra do a soft rollback on a small pool to confirm? jin, can you schedule conservative rollback on two nodes and retest?

jin: Scheduling rollback to 535.8 on canary-2 nodes in eu-west. Coordinating with deploybot and oncall. ETA ~40m.

deploy-bot: Action queued: add pin-hold runtime=3.2.0 region=eu-west reason='driver mismatch causing quantized model divergence' by @sam. Routing override for model_family=quant-v4b -> hosted queued as well.

katy: I'll draft a short release-note blurb: "Temporary pin-hold applied to runtime 3.2.0 in eu-west due to GPU driver regression affecting quantized model outputs; routing override to hosted for impacted model families; rollback test in progress."

mira: Also add to support playbook: include these sample prompts and the failing batch_size param so SRE can reproduce quickly.

sam: Thanks team. If canary rollback looks good we'll scale the rollback and lift pin-hold after validation. :thumbsup:

jin: Will update this thread with rollback results and logs.

oncall-eng: Canary rollback complete on 2 nodes. Re-running preflight now.

oncall-eng: Preflight after rollback: no divergence at batch_size=48, outputs align with hosted baseline.

mira: Great — looks like kernel 540.2 was the culprit. Recommend keeping pin-hold until we coordinate a safe kernel upgrade with infra QA.

sam: Agreed. I'll keep the pin-hold and routing override in place and file a follow-up ticket for a staged kernel rollout with expanded QA. Thanks everyone.
